description: List builds and event/session/player counts. Requires analytics:read. By default returns the newest 50 builds; use build_id for an exact older build. Event counts are not per-metric sample counts or proof that ingestion is complete.

build_id.description: Exact SDK-reported build_id; avoids the newest-50 list cap

fresh.description: Bypass the aggregation cache (default false); useful when checking newly ingested samples

name: list_builds
title: List Builds
